To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new arisugacin, arisugacine K, has been isolated from the endophytic fungus Penicillium echnulatum pt‐ 4, and its absolute stereochemistry has been determined by a combination of quantum chemical calculations and spectroscopic analysis.

a new meroterpine, arisugacine K, and four known ones were isolated from the marine fungus P. echinulatum, and that the structure of the new one was determined by spectroscopic methods and quantum chemical calculations and the absolute configurations of all compounds were determined by comparison of the experimental and calculated electronic circular dichroism spectra.
a new meroterpine, arisugacine K (1) and four known compounds, arisugacing J (2), C (4), G (3) and territrem (5) were obtained from the culture of an endophytic strain of Penicilium echinulata.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of the natural product arisugacin A, a meroterpenoid produced by Penicillium sp. and with its biological evaluation.
the development of a novel class of heterocyclic compounds with potential biological activity.
the isolation of new compounds and the investigation of their bioactivities.

the results obtained by using the two different techniques, i.e., the NMR and quantum chemical calculations in this study, are in good agreement, thus providing a reliable and efficient tool for determining the absolute configuration of meroterpenes.
the use of the new method is not only feasible, but also more accurate and more reliable than the conventional method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the absolute configurations of arisugacines and territremes were unambiguosly determined and their biosynthetic pathways were discussed.
we isolated and identified a new meroterpenoid, arisugacine K (1) from the culture broth of Penicillum echinulatum Pt-4.
the isolation of arisugacines K, J, G, and C and territrem from the culture of P. echinulatum PT‐4 is reported here for the first time.

we have discovered a novel class of natural products with interesting biological properties, and we have shown that these products can be produced on a large scale.
